    Observed scope
    
The live root was div#prompt-textarea[role=textbox][contenteditable=true] with paragraph children and a ProseMirror-trailingBreak on empty paragraphs. A native insertion of alpha\nbeta produced two paragraphs; a blank line produced an empty paragraph. In two no-Send probes, inserting *bold* _under_ `code`  returned success from execCommand but left the editor empty. The checkbox reproduces only that observed case; it is not a general Markdown parser.
